chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Jelly Roll's respectable Creole family and the District
summary: Smitty and Milt say Jelly was classically trained, and Danny says his grandmother chased him out for staying out late.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, well, gee, yeah, you should know about him. He came out of... He was Classically trained. Well, Ferdinand, he come from kind of a first-class family, now, and...

Well, it was a respectable family. It had a whole lot of poor people, but highly respectable. They didn't have nothin' much. His mother chased him out... His grandmother chased him out because he was coming in late, and he was a bad influence for his sister. Once you went in that District... The District was a fascinating place to be. Because nobody done shit in the District. See, you went in the District and there were.... Nobody picked up nothin' heavier than a slice of bread.
